definitions.explanation: Fish that live in rivers, lakes, and other freshwater bodies, as opposed to those in the sea.

examples.japanese: {鯉|こい}は{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}だ。
{川|かわ}や{湖|みずうみ}に{住|す}む{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I researched freshwater fish that live in rivers and lakes.

examples.japanese: {近年|きんねん}、{外来|がいらい}{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}が{在来|ざいらい}{種|しゅ}を{脅|おびや}かしている。
examples.english: In recent years, non-native freshwater fish have been threatening native species.

notes:
Compound of {淡水|たんすい} (fresh water) + {魚|ぎょ} (fish). Contrasted with {海水魚|かいすいぎょ} (saltwater fish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}の{飼育|しいく}: keeping freshwater fish (in an aquarium)
- {淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}{料理|りょうり}: freshwater-fish cuisine
- {在来|ざいらい}{淡水魚|たんすいぎょ}: native freshwater fish

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- {鯉|こい} (carp), {鮒|ふな} (crucian carp), {鮎|あゆ} (sweetfish), {鰻|うなぎ} (eel), {岩魚|いわな} (char)

SIMILAR / CONTRASTING WORDS:
- {海水魚|かいすいぎょ}: saltwater fish
- {汽水魚|きすいぎょ}: brackish-water fish — lives where fresh and salt water mix
